description: Get the wiring instructions for connecting an MCP client to ~alter. The name is historical and this recommends nothing: it hands back connection details, not a suggested tool. Use it when adding ~alter to a new MCP client, or when passing the endpoint to another agent so it can connect for itself. Returns the MCP endpoint URL, a ready-to-paste JSON configuration snippet, and how many tools are callable at each tier. Takes no parameters and reads no member data. Free L0, no authentication required.
name: recommend_tool
title: Install ~alter
